description: Export one of the user's Canva designs (designId or its Canva link) and save the files into the Hermoso Library, ready to post, schedule or use as ad creative. format png (default), jpg, mp4 or gif (pdf and pptx return Canva's short-lived download link instead of a Library file); pages [1,3] for some pages; quality, width/height (PNG and JPG) and proQuality:true (Canva's lossless pro quality, Pro plans) go to Canva as its export tool takes them, and the answer says if one was left out. A design with unlicensed premium elements fails with that reason. Free.

format.description: png (default), jpg, mp4 or gif saved to the Library; pdf and pptx return a short-lived download link

height.description: output height in pixels, 40 to 25000; PNG and JPG only

pages.description: page numbers to export, e.g. [1, 3]; omit for all pages

proQuality.description: true requests Canva lossless pro quality (Canva Pro plans)

quality.description: export quality, passed to Canva as its export tool takes it

transparentBackground.description: PNG only: true exports a transparent background

width.description: output width in pixels, 40 to 25000; PNG and JPG only

name: export_canva_design
title: Export a Canva design
